title: RNA Precipitation Protocol
author: Liz Hughes
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.73chqiw

steps.title: Prepare RNA solution
steps.instruction: Adjust the volume of the RNA solution to 500μl using RNase free water.

steps.title: Add Sodium Acetate
steps.instruction: Add 50 μl of room temperature 3M Sodium Acetate (pH 5.2-5.5) to the solution.

steps.title: Precipitate RNA
steps.instruction: Add 500 μl of room temperature Propan-2-ol and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Mix by inverting the tube a few times.
Leave at room temperature for 15-20 mins.

steps.title: Pellet the RNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the mixture to pellet the precipitated RNA.

substeps.instruction: Note the side of the tube where the pellet is located.

steps.title: Wash the RNA pellet
steps.instruction: Wash the pellet twice with 70% ice cold ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Wash the pellet with 500μl 70% ice cold ethanol, ensuring the pellet is not dislodged.
Repeat the wash and spin process one more time (total of 2 ethanol washes).
Carefully remove all of the ethanol.

steps.title: Dry the pellet
steps.instruction: Dry the pellet at room temperature for 5-30 mins with the tube positioned upside down on tissue.

steps.title: Resuspend and assess RNA
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in RNase free water and verify quality.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend in an appropriate volume of RNase free water (usually 30-50μl).
Assess RNA quantity and integrity using the NanoDrop and Fragment Analyzer.
